# UT2004VR configuration

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-config-docs.py from the source; edit the comments in the classes, then re-run. -->

Most players never need this page: the defaults are tuned, and the console commands in the README cover
the usual adjustments. Everything here can still be changed.

**Where settings live** (all in the game's `System` folder):
- `UT2004VR.ini`: the mod's settings, created on first run. Sections `[UT2004VR.VRPlayerController]`,
  `[UT2004VR.VRTuning]` (what the tuning commands save: grips, scopes, seats...) and `[UT2004VR.VRGame]`.
- `UT2004VR_proxy.ini`: the d3d9 proxy (resolution, panels, desktop mirror).
- `UT2004VR_Game.ini`: the game's own settings for VR launches (made by `Play-VR.bat` from `UT2004.ini`).

Change a setting while the game is closed, or from the console with
`set UT2004VR.VRPlayerController <Setting> <value>` (saved at once). Values in uu are Unreal units:
52.5 uu is about 1 m.

## Movement and turning

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bHandRelativeMove` | `False` | Alyx "hand" vs "head" oriented continuous locomotion |
| `bGazeHeading` | `true` | move along a body heading that turns toward the gaze while moving forward |
| `HeadingTurnRate` | `2` | that turn: rate per second per unit of forward stick, proportional to the angle |
| `bSteerByGaze` | `true` | seated head steering: walking forward while looking aside turns the view itself |
| `SteerGain` | `1.5` | turn speed in deg/s per degree of look angle (times forward stick) |
| `SteerDeadzone` | `8` | degrees of look angle that do not steer |
| `SteerMaxDegPerSec` | `120` | ... at most this fast (deg/s) |
| `ChairHistLife` | `60` | s: how long a look counts toward your chair's forward |
| `bSmoothTurn` | `False` | right stick turns smoothly instead of in snaps (VRSnap 0) |
| `SnapTurnDegrees` | `45` | degrees per snap turn (VRSnap &lt;degrees&gt;) |
| `SmoothTurnDegPerSec` | `120` | smooth turn speed at full stick (deg/s) |
| `MoveSpeedScale` | `1` | fraction of UT's GroundSpeed at full stick (UT is fast for VR) |
| `bTeleport` | `true` | right stick forward aims a teleport arc; release to blink there |
| `TeleportSpeed` | `1100` | arc launch speed, uu/s |
| `TeleportMaxDist` | `1600` | longest teleport (uu) |
| `CrouchHeadMeters` | `1.1` | physical crouch threshold (head height above floor) |
| `bVignette` | `true` | comfort vignette: the view's edges darken while moving or turning |
| `bJumpOnStickClick` | - | old bindings with jump on the left stick click: ignore clicks while the stick is pushed |

## Height and world scale

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `UUPerMeter` | `52.5` | world scale; UT2004 is ~52.5 uu per meter |
| `bAutoHeight` | `true` | seated-friendly: map your head height at spawn/recenter to StandEyeMeters |
| `StandEyeMeters` | `1.62` | ... the eye height that maps to (m) |
| `bMatchGameHeight` | `True` | eyes at the pawn's stock eye height (UT2004: 44 + 38 = 82 uu), whatever your real height |
| `EyeHeightBonus` | `0` | uu added to that (VRHeight) |
| `bSeatedAutoLevel` | `true` | seated: slowly re-level the eye height (posture changes, tracking drift) |
| `AutoLevelSeconds` | `15` | time constant of that re-levelling |
| `NeckModelMode` | `2` | the eyes' turning arc: 2 while the headset tracks rotation only, 1 always, 0 never |
| `NeckForward` | `0.09` | the eyes from the neck pivot (m) |
| `NeckUp` | `0.1` | the eyes from the neck pivot (m) |
| `NeckBlendTime` | `0.3` | ... blended in / out over this many seconds |

## Weapons, laser and recoil

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bWeapons` | `true` | false = travel only (no guns) |
| `GunOffset` | `(X=0,Y=0,Z=0)` | gun's visual centre relative to the controller tip, in aim space (uu) |
| `GunPitchOffset` | `-1820` | tilts the gun relative to the controller (rotation units, 65536 = 360 deg; VRGunPitch &lt;deg&gt;) |
| `FlipGuns` | - | exceptions to the up rule (VRGunFlip): roll these 180 |
| `GunScale` | `1` | first-person meshes are ~1.7x real size (they sit next to the camera) |
| `MuzzleForward` | `4` | muzzle this far ahead of the controller before the gun is measured (uu) |
| `bLaser` | `true` | aiming laser from the muzzle to whatever the gun points at |
| `LaserRange` | `12000` | how far the laser reaches (uu) |
| `LaserDotDeg` | `0.35` | the laser dot's red core: how wide it looks (deg), the same at any distance |
| `LaserBrightness` | `0.45` | 0..1 (additive, so this is its translucency) |
| `LaserWidth` | `0.6` | the laser beam's width (uu) |
| `LaserFadeIn` | `0.5` | seconds to fade back in after firing stops (hidden while firing) |
| `RecoilScale` | `1` | 0 = off |
| `RecoilReturn` | `0.22` | seconds the gun takes to spring most of the way back |

## Keyboard and mouse mode

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `KBMGunOffset` | `(X=16,Y=10,Z=-6)` | that gun's handle relative to the chest point, in aim axes (uu) |
| `KBMChestBelowEyes` | `0.32` | chest point: this far (m) below the stock eye height |
| `GunLagTime` | `0.12` | keyboard/mouse: the gun eases back to its place over this many seconds when you move |
| `GunLagMax` | `0.015` | ... lagging at most this far (m); 0 = off |
| `GunLagSmooth` | `0.15` | ... easing in and out over this many seconds |

## Scope (zoom)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bScope` | `true` | zoom (Lightning Gun, Sniper alt-fire): a magnified picture in a round lens |
| `ScopeDiameter` | `0.1` | controller mode: lens size (m), held on the gun above your hand |
| `ScopeOffset` | `(X=0.02,Y=0,Z=0.07)` | controller mode: lens centre from the gun's handle (m; forward, right, up) |
| `ScopeKBMDiameter` | `0.21` | keyboard mode: lens size (m), in the middle of your aim |
| `ScopeKBMDistance` | `0.54` | keyboard mode: how far ahead of your eyes (m) |
| `ScopeMinZoom` | `2` | magnification at the start of a zoom (UT's own zoom raises it) |
| `ScopeRes` | `512` | the scope picture's resolution (pixels) |
| `ScopeStickZoom` | `0.6` | controller mode, zoomed: the right stick forward / back zooms in / out at this rate (UT zoom levels per second; 0 = off) |

## Guided Redeemer

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `RedeemerSteer` | `2000` | controller mode: right stick -&gt; guided Redeemer turn rate (negative: inverted pitch) |
| `bRedeemerRoll` | `false` | ride the warhead's banking too (off: the horizon only pitches and turns) |
| `bRedeemerWindow` | `true` | ride behind a round window at the warhead's tip (2D's scope overlay, in 3D) |
| `RedeemerWindowDeg` | `80` | how wide the window looks from your seat (degrees) |
| `RedeemerWindowDist` | `0.6` | how far ahead of you it is (m) |

## Vehicles and turrets

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `VehicleTurnDegPerSec` | `120` | controller mode: the right stick left / right turns Manta, Raptor and Cicada (the vehicles that face your view) this fast |
| `bVehicleHandAim` | `true` | controller mode: flying vehicles (space fighters, Raptor, Cicada) and turrets / gunner seats aim with the right controller, as a weapon does; your head looks around freely |
| `TurretEdgeDeg` | `35` | turrets and gunner seats: when the crosshair is this far (deg) from where you look, the seat's view turns toward it |
| `TurretEdgeTurn` | `3` | ... at this many deg/s per degree past that edge |
| `TurretEdgeMaxDegPerSec` | `45` | ... at most this fast (deg/s; TurretEdgeTurn 0 = off) |
| `VehicleBehindPitch` | `12` | behind view in a vehicle: the camera looks down this much (deg)... |
| `VehicleBehindScale` | `1` | ...from UT's chase distance times this |
| `GazeSteerFollow` | `0.3` | Manta/Raptor (they turn toward your gaze): how fast the view follows the vehicle (1/s) |
| `TurretSpeed` | `0.6` | vehicle guns that turn at a set rate (Goliath cannon): that rate times this |
| `InstantTurretSpeed` | `0` | guns UT turns instantly to the view (turrets, Hellbender): turns/s (0: instant, as UT) |
| `bVehicleLaser` | `true` | in vehicles: the laser from the gun's muzzle (else a crosshair at its hit point) |
| `ASTurretFollow` | `0.15` | Assault turrets follow your gaze over this many seconds |

## Assault space fighters

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bFighterGazeSteer` | `true` | controller mode, Assault's space fighters: the ship turns toward your gaze (the steering crosshair), banking into the turn; hold the left stick click for freelook |
| `FighterGazeGain` | `3` | ... turn rate per degree the crosshair is off the nose (deg/s per deg) |
| `FighterBankPerDeg` | `1.5` | ... bank (deg) per degree the crosshair is to the side, up to FighterMaxBank |
| `FighterMaxBank` | `45` | ... the most it banks (deg) |
| `FighterInertia` | `0` | controller mode: seconds the fighter takes to wind up / settle a turn from the stick (0 = instant) |
| `FighterSteer` | `2000` | controller mode: right stick -&gt; Assault space fighter pitch / yaw rate, as the mouse (negative: inverted pitch) |

## Behind view

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `BehindDistance` | `1.8` | behind view on foot (F): the camera this far behind you (m)... |
| `BehindHeight` | `0.45` | ...and this far above your eyes (m)... |
| `BehindRight` | `0.35` | ...and this far to the right (m; over the shoulder, so the gun and laser show) |

## HUD, messages and scoreboard

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bVRHud` | `true` | head-locked HUD (health, shield, adrenaline, ammo, score) at a real 3D depth |
| `HudDistance` | `2.5` | meters in front of the eyes |
| `HudSpread` | `1.9` | scales how far the items sit from the centre of view |
| `HudTopUp` | `0.44` | top row height (m at HudDistance, before HudSpread) |
| `HudSize` | `0.85` | HUD digits and icons, relative to the original size |
| `HudLower` | `0.05` | moves the whole HUD (items, messages, scoreboard) down by this much |
| `HudBottomUp` | `-0.65` | bottom row height (negative = below the centre) |
| `bVROriginalHud` | `true` | the headset shows the game type's own HUD (captured), not the drawn VR HUD items |
| `OriginalHudScale` | `1` | ... that HUD's width, relative to the VR HUD's (its corners at +-0.62 x HudSpread) |
| `bVRScoreboardOriginal` | `true` | the headset shows UT's own scoreboard (captured by the proxy), not the drawn one |
| `ScoresWidthDeg` | `40` | scoreboard panel width (degrees); the font size follows from it |
| `bVRClock` | `true` | match clock at the top centre of the VR HUD |
| `bVRMessages` | `true` | UT's game messages (pickups, first blood, sprees, kills, chat) in the VR HUD |
| `VRMessageFontBoost` | `2` | message fonts this many sizes bigger than UT's choice for the same screen |

## Desktop window

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bMirrorFitHud` | `true` | desktop window: crop the eye around the VR HUD (centred, all of it visible) |
| `MirrorHudMargin` | `0.1` | ... with this margin around the HUD's corners (HUD units, like HudTopUp) |

## Debugging

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `bDebugLog` | `false` | extra diagnostics in UT2004.log |
| `TestExec` | - | debug: console command run once ~3 s after spawn |
| `bCalib` | - | debug: projection test markers at known angles |
| `bCalibGun` | - | debug: mark the muzzle and candidate barrel lines in the eye images |

## Saved tuning (`[UT2004VR.VRTuning]`)

Written by the tuning console commands; the defaults are the author's play-tested set.

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Grips` | `(list)` | Per-weapon handle offset in controller mode: `VRGrip &lt;forward&gt; &lt;right&gt; &lt;up&gt;` (uu), `VRGripReset`. |
| `KBMGrips` | `(list)` | The same for keyboard mode. |
| `Scopes` | `(list)` | Per-weapon scope lens position: `VRScope &lt;forward&gt; &lt;right&gt; &lt;up&gt; [diameter]` (m), `VRScopeReset`. |
| `VehSeats` | `(list)` | Per-vehicle seat offset and model visibility: `VRSeat &lt;forward&gt; &lt;right&gt; &lt;up&gt;` (uu), `VRSeatMesh`. |
| `FlipGuns` | - | Weapons whose model is upside down: `VRGunFlip`. |

## The VR deathmatch (`[UT2004VR.VRGame]`)

Used by `Play-VR.bat <MapName>`; games started from the menus use the menus' own settings.

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `VRNumBots` | `7` | bots to fight (URL ?NumBots=N overrides) |
| `BotSkill` | `0` | UT difficulty 0 (Novice) .. 7 (Godlike); URL ?Difficulty=N overrides |
| `BotNames` | - | scoreboard names: "" = UT's roster names, or your own names, comma-separated |
| `ExtraWeapon` | - | e.g. XWeapons.ShockRifle: also given at spawn (testing, or a favourite gun) |

## Proxy (`UT2004VR_proxy.ini`, section `[VR]`)

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `RenderScale` | `0.85` | Eye resolution as a fraction of SteamVR's recommended size. Lower it if the frame rate drops. |
| `GPUShare` | `1` | 1: run the game on D3D9Ex and hand the eye images to SteamVR on the GPU (fast). 0: CPU copy (slow fallback). |
| `Port` | `7790` | Local UDP port for poses from the proxy to the game; the game's `[UT2004VR.VRLink] VRPort` must match. |
| `MirrorEye` | `0` | Desktop window: 0 left eye, 1 right eye, -1 a plain mono view. |
| `MirrorFill` | `1` | 1: crop the eye to fill the window. 0: letterbox the whole eye view. |
| `MirrorZoom` | `1.08` | Above 1 widens the mirror slightly past the lens edge. |
| `PanelDistance` | `0.95` | Menu panel distance (m). |
| `PanelWidth` | `1.6` | Menu panel width (m). |
| `PanelCurvature` | `0.6` | 0 flat, 1 a cylinder centred on your head. |
| `PanelFollowDeg` | `0` | Main menus: look this far away for 1.5 s and the panel comes back in front of you (0 off). |
| `ScoreboardDistance` | `1.0` | Scoreboard panel distance (m), when it has its own panel (bVROriginalHud off). |
| `ScoreboardWidth` | `1.5` | Scoreboard panel width (m). |
| `SpectatorBarDistance` | `1.0` | UT's spectator bar: distance (m). |
| `SpectatorBarWidth` | `1.3` | ... width (m). |
| `SpectatorBarDrop` | `0.3` | ... how far below eye level (m). |
| `ScreenDistance` | `2.4` | Online (no VR on the server): the flat game on a big screen this far away (m). |
| `ScreenWidth` | `3.2` | ... and this wide (m). |
| `LeftHanded` | `0` | Written by the game from Settings &gt; Player &gt; Weapon Hand (controller mode). Don't edit. |
| `Mock, MockDemo, DumpEyes, DumpEyesStart, DumpEyesStep` | `0` | Developer tests: a simulated headset and eye image dumps (see DEVELOPMENT.md). |
